name: draw_text
evidence: drawtext builds the text in it, up to 1000 letters and an end mark

name: draw_number
evidence: drawtext formats one number or string in it before it adds it to the text

name: glext
evidence: flags of the OpenGL extensions that the client checks at start. The Linux client names the symbol glext, 0x44 bytes. Entry 8 is the two sided stencil and entry 9 the separate stencil operation

name: programs
evidence: setupprogramobjects and compileprogramobject: one record of 0x50 bytes for each of the ten shader programs

name: shader_log
evidence: compileprogramobject adds the info logs to it. setupprogramobjects writes it to shaderoutput.txt

name: info_log
evidence: compileprogramobject reads the info log of an object into it

name: render_width
evidence: setupprogramobjects gives the shaders the size of one pixel: 1 over this width

name: render_height
evidence: setupprogramobjects gives the shaders the size of one pixel: 1 over this height

name: shader_file
evidence: setupprogramobjects keeps the handle of shaderoutput.txt in it

name: light_position
evidence: the direction of the light, in world space. The model, landscape, sector and sky passes pass it to OpenGL and to the shaders

name: world_position
evidence: renderframeatmosphere and render_sectorlist pass it to the shaders as the world position

name: viewport_width
evidence: renderframeatmosphere sets the viewport from it

name: viewport_height
evidence: renderframeatmosphere sets the viewport from it

name: track_vbo
evidence: rendertrackmodel: the index into vbo of the buffer of the track

name: track_vertex_floats
evidence: rendertrackmodel: the floats of one vertex of the track buffer

name: track_vertex_count
evidence: rendertrackmodel: the vertices of the track buffer

name: frustum_planes
evidence: boxinsidefrustum writes the five plane normals into it each time it runs

name: shadow_corners
evidence: rendermodelshadow: the three pushed corners and the three corners of the triangle in work

name: shadow_count
evidence: rendermodelshadow: the points in the list of the shadow

name: shadow_list
evidence: rendermodelshadow: the triangles of the shadow volume, as points

name: chat_head
evidence: frame_drawmessages walks the ring of messages from this index back. createmessage moves it

name: sprite_models
evidence: createsprite_model and sprite_model_simulation: the flying pieces. A record has 0x68 bytes

name: sprite_model_count
evidence: createsprite_model adds 1. deletesprite_model moves the last piece into the freed place

name: shell_count
evidence: sprite_model_simulation adds the corners of a landed shell casing to shell_verts

name: shell_verts
evidence: the corners of the landed shell casings. renderspritemodels draws them

name: debris_count
evidence: sprite_model_simulation adds the corners of a landed piece of debris to debris_verts

name: debris_verts
evidence: the corners of the landed pieces of debris. renderspritemodels draws them

name: level_hit
evidence: lineintersectlevel writes the point and the normal of the hit into it

name: score_count
evidence: drawplayerinfo: the number of players in the column that it builds

name: score_entries
evidence: drawplayerinfo: the player and the worth of each player of the column, before the sort

name: sort_count
evidence: the number of entries of the sort list: drawplayerinfo and the passes that sort by depth fill it before the sort call

name: sort_order
evidence: the result of the sort call: the entry numbers from the lowest key

name: sort_keys
evidence: the keys that the sort call reads, one for each entry

name: map_shown
evidence: drawhud: not zero draws the map over the display

name: free_for_all
evidence: 1 when the game type is 3: drawhud hides the map then

name: view_zoom
evidence: the zoom of the view: 1 normally, larger while a gun aims. drawhud scales the aim marks by it

name: cheat
evidence: drawdisplay and displaydebuginfo: not zero shows every chat line in the debug mode

name: display_text
evidence: drawdisplay builds a stock price or a chat line in it before drawtext

name: round_ticks
evidence: drawdisplay: the ticks of the timed round, shown as minutes, seconds and tenths

name: round_goal
evidence: drawdisplay: the right number of the round score line
